title: Finite projective dimension of the residue field is at most the Krull dimension
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$, and let $\dim R$ be its Krull dimension (the supremum of the lengths $l$ of chains $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\dots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_l$ of prime ideals of $R$). If $\kappa$ has finite projective dimension as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension], then $\operatorname{pd}_R\kappa\le\dim R$; in particular $\dim R$ is finite and $\kappa$ has a projective resolution of length $\le\dim R$.
